Junior Power Platform Developer
Job Location
US
Job ID 2026-4470 Fill Type Proposal
Overview

At ITA International, we’re a tech-enabled professional services company. Headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, we leverage subject matter expertise, data analytics and technology to challenge boundaries and transform possibilities. 

 

With a global presence and a passionate team of over 200 ITAers, we’re driven by mission success for our customers, “In The Arena.” Our expertise spans Operations, Training, Engineering, Nanotechnology, Statistics, Machine Learning and Software Engineering – enabling data and tech-enabled solutions that deliver real value. 

 

Join our impactful journey at ITA International. As Theodore Roosevelt said, “The credit belongs to the man who is actually in the arena.” We’re here, standing beside our customers, ready to serve and succeed. 

 

ITA is seeking a Junior Power Platform Developer to join our team.

Responsibilities

The Junior Power Platform Developer supports the design, development, and implementation of automation and business process solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform suite, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Working alongside senior developers, business analysts, and project managers, this individual will help streamline business processes, reduce manual effort, and develop technology-enabled solutions that support government and commercial customers. 

This position is ideal for an early-career professional with a strong interest in automation, low-code application development, data management, and digital transformation. 

Responsibilities: 

Power Platform Development 

Develop and maintain Power Apps applications to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency.  
Build and support Power Automate workflows to streamline data collection, approvals, notifications, and reporting processes.  
Assist in creating user-friendly forms, applications, and interfaces that improve the user experience and support mission requirements.  
Support the development of dashboards and reports using Power BI and other reporting tools.  

Business Process Automation 

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.  
Document requirements, workflows, and system functionality to support solution development.  
Assist in converting manual and spreadsheet-based processes into automated workflows and digital solutions.  

Data Integration & Management 

Support the integration of data from SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Dataverse, Excel, SQL databases, and other enterprise systems.  
Assist in data validation, cleansing, and transformation activities to ensure data quality and reliability.  
Help maintain data structures, permissions, and system configurations.  

Testing & Deployment 

Participate in application testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.  
Support deployment activities and assist with user acceptance testing (UAT).  
Document technical solutions, user guides, and training materials.  

Customer & Team Collaboration 

Work closely with project teams, customers, and stakeholders to ensure solutions meet business requirements.  
Participate in Agile ceremonies, project meetings, and design reviews.  
Provide responsive customer support for deployed applications and workflows.  

 

 

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Data Analytics, Engineering, Communications, or a related field.  
0–3 years of experience in application development, automation, business analysis, or related technical work.  
Familiarity with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or similar low-code/no-code platforms.  
Basic understanding of databases, data structures, and workflow automation concepts.  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.  
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

 

Desired Qualifications: 

Experience developing Power Apps or Power Automate workflows through coursework, internships, or professional experience.  
Familiarity with Power BI, Dataverse, SQL, or SharePoint Online.  
Understanding of Agile development methodologies.  
Experience supporting government, defense, or public sector customers.  
Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900) certification or willingness to obtain within the first year of employment. 
Active Secret clearance or experience supporting the United States Government 

 

Benefit and Compensation Transparency

ITA International proudly complies with all federal and state benefit and pay transparency laws. Employees of ITA can expect a robust benefit package, including:

Medical, dental and vision plans
Life Insurance
Short Term Disability insurance (where applicable)
Voluntary ancillary benefit options
401k retirement benefits with employer matching contributions

Pay range for this position is $75,000 - $125,000 annually.

 

This position has a broad compensation range due to the complexities of government contracting, including contract pricing, labor category requirements, funding parameters, and varying levels of candidate experience and qualifications.

Application and Employment at ITA International

ITA International is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), ITA International would like to ensure that your application process goes as smoothly as possible. If you would like to preview the physical requirements for this position, or if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a currently open position with ITA, please contact us by phone at 757-246-6781 or email us at HR@ita-intl.com.
